criteria.question: Can a history-bearing learner learn the probe->commit mapping from demonstrations on the final B2K2 spec, and does that ability depend on history?
criteria.signature: per-run Spearman(speed_at_reveal, mu) on held-out closed-loop episodes

paired_bootstrap.rule: CI of per-seed (history - current) must exclude 0 (low > 0)

fail_semantics.history_lt_0.8: TEACHER/TASK REWORK -- task or demonstration design goes back; no RL escalation
fail_semantics.history_geq_0.8_and_current_gt_0.4: CURRENT-FRAME LEAK -- gate self-check fails; route to P4 protocol review
fail_semantics.medians_ok_ci_contains_0: UNDERPOWERED -- more seeds/demos and rerun; no claim
fail_semantics.history_lt_0.8_and_current_gt_0.4: LEAK + WEAK TEACHER -- P4 review first, then teacher rework

auxiliary_non_adjudicating: history-arm hidden-reset ablation at the commitment step (signature should degrade)
free-prior hedge baseline (medium-bin best fixed plan) signature
per-arm panel success vs the gate-3 bar from the final spec
preparation-segment action energy vs the no-probe baseline (S2 analogue)

design_constants.optimizer: Adam lr=0.001, epochs=25, batch=16 episodes, MSE, grad clip 1.0
design_constants.eval_pairing: identical (mu, env seed) eval set for every run and arm
design_constants.teacher: track v0=8 (steps 0..11), full-brake pulse (12..21), commit v_oracle_est(mu) from step 22, reactive swerve post-reveal

claim_boundary: Feasibility-audit ignition-gate measurement only: scripted per-mu oracle demonstrations and minutes-scale supervised imitation probes of HISTORY DEPENDENCE on the final B2K2 commitment family. No driver-performance, repair-success, robustness-result, validation, ranking, promotion, paper, or self-ID *capability* claim is made.
